terms.description: Searches the deck for Pokémon (Ultra Ball, Nest Ball, Buddy-Buddy Poffin).
Searches the deck for Trainer cards (Arven).
Searches the deck for Energy cards.
Draws cards or refreshes the hand (Professor's Research, Iono, Lillie's Determination).
Attaches extra Energy from the hand beyond the one-per-turn attachment.
Attaches Energy from the deck.
Attaches Energy from the discard pile.
Moves Energy between your own Pokémon (Energy Switch).
Evolves faster than normal, such as skipping a stage or evolving on the first turn (Rare Candy).
Switches your own Active Pokémon or reduces Retreat Cost.
Switches the opponent's Active Pokémon with a Benched one (Boss's Orders, Counter Catcher).
Heals damage from your own Pokémon.
Shrinks or reshuffles the opponent's hand (Iono, Judge).
Discards or moves the opponent's Energy.
Damages or places damage counters on more than one of the opponent's Pokémon, or on Benched ones.
Discards cards from your hand as a cost or effect (Ultra Ball, Professor's Research).
Returns Pokémon from the discard pile to the hand or deck (Night Stretcher).
Returns Energy from the discard pile to the hand or deck.
Returns Trainer cards from the discard pile.
Lets you have more than 5 Benched Pokémon (Area Zero Underdepths).
Energy attached to your Pokémon, usually to pay attack costs.
Energy cards in your discard pile.
A large hand, such as attacks that scale with hand size.
Many Benched Pokémon, yours or the opponent's.
Damage counters on your own Pokémon.
Pokémon in your discard pile.
Being behind on Prize cards, or the opponent having taken Prizes.
Pokémon Tools attached to your Pokémon.
A Stadium in play, often a specific one.
Stops the opponent's Abilities from working.
Stops the opponent from playing Item cards.
Prevents or reduces damage done to your Pokémon.
Protects your Benched Pokémon from damage or effects.
